scheme_name: 6 Varsh Se Adhik Aayu Ke Bahuviklang Aur Mansik Roop Se Aviksit Nisaktjan Ke Liye Sahayata Anudan Yojana
other_conditions: Must have a disability certificate of at least 40%.
Applicant's name must be listed on the Samagra portal and verified on the Sparsh portal.
Must possess an age certificate confirming they are above six years.
benefits_summary: Eligible disabled persons receive a monthly cash assistance of ₹600.
documents_required: Age certificate (proving age above six years)
